quote.author: Mike Vorkunov
quote.text: The NBA and sportsbooks it works with have implemented new gambling restrictions ahead of the 2026-27 season. That includes restricting bets on certain events, low-minutes players, and high payout under parlays. This will apply for 2027 WNBA season too. www.nytimes.com/athletic/769...

media.title: NBA, sportsbooks to restrict bets on single plays, other ‘low-likelihood, high-payout’ wagers (Gift Article)
media.description: The league and the sportsbooks it works with have agreed to restrict bets on what it calls "single-event player markets."
